import bpy
import bmesh
import mathutils
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
bpy.ops.wm.stl_import(filepath='/workspace/qualification/artifacts/source_mesh.stl')
obj=bpy.context.object
obj.name='IndependentPreparedCube'
obj.location.z=3
bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=True,rotation=False,scale=False)
bm=bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(obj.data)
bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces)
bm.to_mesh(obj.data)
bm.free()
obj.data.update()
bpy.ops.wm.stl_export(filepath='/workspace/qualification/artifacts/repaired_mesh.stl',export_selected_objects=True)
scene=bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
scene.render.resolution_x=256
scene.render.resolution_y=256
scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
scene.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG'
scene.render.filepath='/workspace/qualification/artifacts/mesh-preview.png'
scene.render.film_transparent=False
scene.display.shading.color_type='SINGLE'
scene.display.shading.single_color=(0.2,0.6,0.9)
camera_data=bpy.data.cameras.new('QualificationCamera')
camera=bpy.data.objects.new('QualificationCamera',camera_data)
scene.collection.objects.link(camera)
camera.location=(25,-35,25)
camera.rotation_euler=(mathutils.Vector((0,0,3))-camera.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
camera.data.type='ORTHO'
camera.data.ortho_scale=18
scene.camera=camera
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
print('Actual source imported, placed on bed, normals recalculated, STL and native geometry PNG exported')
